title: The Cozy Cave Clue
intro: This quiz follows Lila and Owen as they learn how hibernation helps some animals survive winter.

choices: A long period of deep rest during cold months
A journey to a warmer country
A way animals build nests
A type of hunting
questions.explanation: Hibernation is a long period of deep rest during cold months.

choices: To avoid sunlight
To save energy when food is scarce and temperatures are low
To grow new fur
To learn how to hunt
questions.explanation: Some animals hibernate to save energy when food is scarce and temperatures are low.

questions.prompt: What happens to an animal's body during hibernation?
choices: Its heart rate and breathing slow down
Its heart beats much faster
It grows larger every day
Its body becomes warmer than usual
questions.explanation: During hibernation, an animal's heart rate and breathing slow down.

questions.prompt: How do many animals prepare before hibernating?
choices: They eat extra food and store body fat
They stop eating for several months beforehand
They drink only cold water
They shed all their fur
questions.explanation: Many animals prepare for hibernation by eating extra food and storing body fat.

questions.prompt: Which place could provide shelter for a hibernating animal?
choices: A cave, burrow, or hollow log
An open field with no cover
The middle of a busy road
A tree branch during a storm
questions.explanation: A cave, burrow, or hollow log could provide shelter for a hibernating animal.
